Downloads weather observations published by the Japan Meteorological Agency, with records back to 1976, and reads typhoon best-track data and earthquake records. On [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jmastats); documentation at [uribo.github.io/jmastats](https://uribo.github.io/jmastats/); source on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/jmastats).
